question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution: The correct answer is** "preceding."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Preceding"** means coming before something in time or order. (किसी व्यक्ति या वस्तु से पहले विद्यमान या घटित होना) • **Example**: *The paintings are a development of ideas she explored in the **preceding**__ decade.* • In the given sentence, the blank needs a word that describes something that comes before. • The correct answer is **option 4.** Correct passage: The Great Depression was a severe __worldwide__ economic depression in the decade __**preceding**__ World War II. In most countries the depression ______ (3) ______ in about 1929 and lasted until the late 1930s or early 1940s. It was the longest, most widespread, and deepest depression of the 20th century. In the 21st century, the Great Depression is commonly used as an example of how far the world's economy can ______ (4) ______ .The depression originated in the U.S. Economic historians usually ______ (5) ______ the start of the Great Depression to the sudden devastating collapse of US stock market prices on 29 October 1929, known as Black Tuesday; some dispute this conclusion, and see the stock crash as a symptom, rather than a cause, of the Great Depression. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **"Proceeding"** means continuing or moving forward. (जारी रखना या आगे बढ़ना) • **"Receding"** means moving back or away from something. (किसी चीज़ से पीछे या दूर जाना) • **"Succeeding"** means coming after or following something. (किसी चीज़ के पीछे आना या अनुसरण करना) 58:T102e, The correct answer is** "started."**
